summary: Read two singly linked chains that are both non-empty. Each chain stores a non-negative integer with the ones digit at the front and higher places farther along, and every node holds exactly one digit. Sum both integers and represent that total with a chain in the same low-place-first layout. Neither input carries an extra high-place zero unless the value itself is zero. Write the head of the chain that stands for the total.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
